description: Per-skill model capability mapping for the provider-neutral skill-mesh router. Transformed faithfully from the legacy .claude/references/model-mapping.md table (Step 34). Consumed by runtime/skill-router.ps1 to decide claude/gpt/local capability. Note text was ASCII-normalized (em-dash -> hyphen); the boolean capability data is preserved exactly, one row per legacy row. Phase CP Step 10 added seven rows that have no legacy row: the promoted workspace-custom skills (build-observer, the four citation-* skills, goblin-sweep, repo-wrap). Their claude/gpt booleans state the adapters this package actually ships for them; local=false records 'not yet assessed' rather than a measured no, matching their deliberate absence from the manifest's LOCAL_CAPABLE set. Without a row here the router warns and falls back to Claude-only for a skill the manifest declares portable.

claude.note: Host-native execution requires no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. 'anthropic-api' names a POSSIBLE future optional transport for parity with the GPT side's Copilot/OpenAI precedence -- unlike Invoke-OpenAIModel, no direct-Anthropic-API call is implemented (Invoke-ClaudeModel is a stub); this entry documents the intended shape only, not landed behavior.

gpt.note: Copilot authentication is tried first and requires no OPENAI_API_KEY. Direct OpenAI is an optional, second fallback transport, tried only if Copilot is unavailable or fails (Step 37).

columns.default_model: Provider to use when neither -Provider nor -Model is passed (legacy default-model column).
columns.claude: Claude variant exists and is functional (legacy claude-capable=Y).
columns.gpt: GPT variant exists and is functional (legacy gpt-capable=Y).
columns.local: Can run on local code-30b, text-only, no vision/sub-agents (legacy local-capable=Y).
